factory_publicly_callable.meaning: createPair on GTELaunchpadV2PairFactory is callable by anyone for any two tokens

fee_requires_launchpad_sender.meaning: factory attaches the launchpad fee-on-transfer mechanism only when msg.sender of createPair is the Launchpad contract

mempool_observable.meaning: attacker can observe the mempool for a launchpad.buy() transaction that will graduate a new token

bonding_curve_fully_sold.meaning: a token's bonding curve is fully sold so the final buy triggers _createPairAndSwapRemaining

catch_swallows_pair_exists.meaning: the try/catch around createPair in _createPairAndSwapRemaining has an empty catch block that swallows the PAIR_EXISTS revert

graduation_completed.meaning: the legitimate launchpad.buy() graduation transaction completes successfully and seeds the pair

claims.scope: Token graduation via launchpad.buy() triggering _createPairAndSwapRemaining and createPair

preconditions.text: The createPair function of GTELaunchpadV2PairFactory.sol is publicly callable by anyone for any two tokens.; The factory enables the launchpad fee-on-transfer mechanism only when msg.sender of createPair is the Launchpad contract; any other caller gets a standard fee-less pair.; The attacker can observe the mempool for a launchpad.buy() transaction that will graduate a new token.; A token's bonding curve is fully sold, so the final buy transaction triggers _createPairAndSwapRemaining.; The try/catch around createPair in _createPairAndSwapRemaining has an empty catch block that swallows the PAIR_EXISTS revert.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: A token whose bonding curve is fully sold should be able to complete graduation: the launchpad's createPair call should succeed and seed the pair with the GTE fee mechanism, rather than being blocked by a pre-existing pair.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: The legitimate launchpad.buy() graduation transaction reverts because the pair already exists and the graduation logic cannot handle that state.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The attacker is able to get their createPair transaction mined before the legitimate graduation transaction by paying a higher gas fee (as_attacker_can_frontrun).
The scenario is described as possible; no real front-running incident is asserted.
The attacker's createPair call is treated as permissionless because the factory is publicly callable.

limitations: Only the direct impact i_graduation_reverts is formalized; i_permanent_dos and i_fee_mechanism_disabled are deferred to future claims.
The front-running ordering is an assumption, not an observed event.
No concrete token pair or attacker token holdings are specified.
Code/PoC binding and SMT model values are deferred.
